section_summary.extract_value: This section presents the results of a single study examining the impact of instructional manipulations on trainees' performance. It found that exploratory learning led to significantly lower performance during training but significantly higher analogical and adaptive transfer. Error encouragement marginally increased adaptive transfer, while emotion-control strategy had no direct impact on any outcomes. The study did not find any significant two- or three-way interactions among the training manipulations.
